divergences.upstreamResult: React maps text editing through its synthetic onChange event layer.
divergences.octaneResult: Octane uses the native input event for per-keystroke DOM wiring while preserving public value callbacks.
divergences.rationale: Octane does not emulate React's synthetic event layer.
divergences.consumerImpact: Native text host handlers use onInput; library value callbacks keep their documented names.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Use onInput for raw text host edits and keep React Aria value callbacks unchanged.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane introduces a synthetic change-event compatibility layer.
